item.title: High school girls basketball: Gibsonburg's Evarts, Elmwood's Deal both have big nights
item.description: Elly Evarts led the Gibsonburg girls basketball team to a 63-26 road win over Sandusky St. Mary on Tuesday.

item.title: A person has been detained for questioning in disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, sheriff's office says
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. — A person has been detained for questioning in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie, officials said Tuesday, offering another potential break in a case that has gripped the nation for more than a week.

item.title: Paige Kohler's 26 points lead Bowling Green women's basketball past Buffalo
item.description: BOWLING GREEN — With the help of a dominant second quarter, the Bowling Green State University women’s basketball team defeated Buffalo 72-61 in a Mid-American Conference game Tuesday at the Stroh Center.

item.title: Start, Lima Senior victorious in City League boys basketball tournament semifinals
item.description: For the second straight season, an all-Spartan showdown will take place in the City League boys basketball tournament championship.

item.title: High school boys basketball: Perrysburg clinches NLL Buckeye title
item.description: Perrysburg boys basketball clinched the Northern Lakes League Buckeye Division title outright with a 71-35 home victory over Findlay on Tuesday.

item.title: Editorial: FBI’s Georgia ballot abuse
item.description: Thanks to a fearless federal judge, the Trump Administration’s seizure of records from Georgia elections storage facilities will get some exposure so that we can learn whether there is a reason for the Department of Justice’s interest in Georgia.

item.title: Hussain: Tangled web of Kashmir and Indo-Pakistan politics
item.description: ISLAMABAD, Pakistan — Last week Pakistan celebrated Kashmir Day. It was an annual official holiday where government offices, educational institutions, and financial institutions were closed. The idea was to reaffirm the nation’s resolve to help Indian-ruled Kashmir break away and join Pakistan. item.title: To the editor: Kaptur knows needs of her district
item.description: I think Alea Nadeem should know who Marcy Kaptur is and why people keep re-electing her. Her mother was an active union member and on the organizing committee to unionize a Toledo factory. Her father ran a small grocery store. Her grandparents emigrated from Poland to escape the war and persecution for a better life in America. Ms. Kaptur was an urban planner for Toledo and Lucas County for 15 years. She knows the district and the people she represents.

item.title: To the editor: Housing costs slow to drop in Ohio
item.description: Some good news to start 2026: The cost of housing is coming down. After years of rising prices in conjunction with post-coronavirus pandemic inflation, more than half of America’s largest metros are seeing home prices drop.
